background: BBVA is Spain's second-largest bank, run as a group of self-funded subsidiaries with Mexico the largest earner alongside Spain, Turkey and South America, and a retail and commercial banking focus.
synthesis: Ratings are solid at A from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026, A+ from S&P and A2 from Moody's, all stable. Capital is mixed against EU and Nordic peers: CET1 of 12.8% is in the bottom quarter, while leverage of 6.2% is above the peer median. Liquidity is also mixed, with LCR of 142% below the peer median and NSFR of 125% just above it, and the ratios have been broadly flat apart from leverage, down 0.3 points since 31 Mar 2024. The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is strong results at the Argentine subsidiary; the others are the trial of the bank and its former chair in the spying case, a conduct matter that does not touch solvency.
